contacts help:
Usage: analyze [OPTIONS] [NAME]

  Run one analysis and print a validated result.

  Give one -c config.yaml for a single-condition summary, or several for a
  comparison with the first config as the control. NAME is rg, rmsd, rmsf,
  rmsd_per_residue, sasa, secondary_structure, contacts, native_contacts,
  hydrogen_bonds or distances. The catalytic triad is a routine on the study
  API: see https://polyzymd.readthedocs.io/en/latest/how_to/analysis_triad_quick
  start.html.

  Examples:
      polyzymd analyze rg -c A/config.yaml
      polyzymd analyze rg -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --eq 10ns
      polyzymd analyze rmsd -c A/config.yaml --set reference_mode=average
      polyzymd analyze distances -c A/config.yaml --set pairs=pairs.yaml
      polyzymd analyze rmsf -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --eq 10ns --run rmsf
      polyzymd analyze rmsd_per_residue -c A/config.yaml --set reference_file=crystal.pdb
      polyzymd analyze sasa -c A/config.yaml --run isolated_residues
      polyzymd analyze secondary_structure -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --run helix_residues
      polyzymd analyze contacts -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --stride 10 --run contact_fraction_residues
      polyzymd analyze contacts -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --set method=distance
      polyzymd analyze hydrogen_bonds -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --format json -o hbonds.json
      polyzymd analyze native_contacts -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --set reference_file=crystal.pdb
      polyzymd analyze hydrogen_bonds -c A/config.yaml -c B/config.yaml --submit --preset blanca-shirts
      polyzymd analyze contacts --study my_study/study.yaml

Options:
  -c, --config PATH       Simulation config.yaml. Repeatable; the first one is
                          the control.
  --project PATH          project.yaml, or the project folder: run NAME (or
                          every analysis) in each study that runs it, as --study
                          would, one study after another.
  --study PATH            study.yaml, or the study folder holding it: gives the
                          conditions, --eq, --stride, --replicates and the
                          settings of NAME, and stores results in
                          <study>/results/NAME/. Options given here override it.
  --data DIRECTORY        Directory holding the run directories of every
                          condition, for this command only, in place of each
                          config's scratch_directory (and of a study's
                          data.local.yaml).
  --replicates TEXT       Replicates to analyze, for example 1-3 or 1,3,5.
                          Default: those found on disk.
  --eq TEXT               Equilibration window to discard from every replicate,
                          for example 10ns.
  --label TEXT            Condition label, one per -c in the same order.
                          Default: the config's directory name.
  --run TEXT              Run or pair label to report when the analysis measures
                          several. Default: the first.
  --list                  List the shipped analyses, what each measures, and its
                          settings with their defaults, then exit. Check here
                          before writing your own function.
  --set TEXT              Top-level analysis setting as key=value, the value
                          read as YAML. Repeatable.
  --format [agent|json]   agent prints one line per condition and comparison;
                          json prints the full ProtocolReport.  [default: agent]
  -o, --output PATH       Also write the rendered output to this file.
  --output-dir PATH       Directory for polyzymd_results/ and figures/. Default:
                          the current directory.
  --stride INTEGER RANGE  Measure every N-th production frame of every
                          replicate. Default 1.  [x>=1]
  --until TEXT            End of a common analysis window, e.g. 38ns: leave out
                          production frames after it, so conditions simulated
                          for different lengths are compared over the same time.
  --recompute             Recompute replicates instead of reusing cached
                          results.
  --no-eq-check           Skip the pymbar detected equilibration start of each
                          replicate. No value changes.
  --no-plots              Draw no figures. By default rg, rmsd, rmsf,
                          rmsd_per_residue, distances, sasa,
                          secondary_structure, contacts, native_contacts and
                          hydrogen_bonds draw theirs into <output-
                          dir>/figures/<name>/.
  --submit                Submit to SLURM instead of running here: one array
                          task per condition and replicate, then a report job
                          that reuses their stored results.
  --dry-run               With --submit, write the SLURM scripts and print the
                          sbatch commands without submitting.
  --preset TEXT           SLURM settings of a cluster for --submit: alpine-cpu,
                          blanca-shirts, blanca-chbe-rdi or bridges2-rm.
  --partition TEXT        SLURM partition for --submit, over the preset.
  --account TEXT          SLURM account for --submit, over the preset.
  --qos TEXT              SLURM QoS for --submit, over the preset.
  --time TEXT             Time limit of each job for --submit. Default 12:00:00.
  --mem TEXT              Memory of each job for --submit. Default 16G.
  --cpus INTEGER RANGE    CPUs of each job for --submit. Default 2.  [x>=1]
  --help                  Show this message and exit.

Settings of this analysis, with their defaults (--set key=value):
contacts: contacts per protein residue with a partner group, the polymer by default or any polymer_selection such as resname SDS: method occlusion (buried surface) or distance
  method: "occlusion"
  polymer_selection: null
  protein_selection: null
  polymer_types: null
  use_pbc: true
  regions: {}
  cutoff: 4.0
  heavy_atoms: true
  exposed_threshold: 0.2
  buried_threshold: 0.2
  max_asa: "theoretical"
  probe_radius_nm: 0.14
  n_sphere_points: 960
  tolerance_ps: 0.0
list:
rg: radius of gyration of a selection per frame (A)
  selection: "protein"
rmsd: RMSD of a selection superposed on a reference, per frame (A)
  selection: "protein and name CA"
  alignment_selection: "protein and name CA"
  reference_mode: null
  reference_frame: 1
  reference_file: null
rmsf: per-residue RMS fluctuation about the mean structure, with core and region means (A)
  selection: "protein and name CA"
  alignment_selection: "protein and name CA"
  reference_mode: null
  reference_frame: 1
  reference_file: null
  highlight_residues: []
  core: null
  regions: {}
rmsd_per_residue: per-residue RMS deviation from a reference structure (A)
  selection: "protein and name CA"
  alignment_selection: "protein and name CA"
  reference_mode: null
  reference_frame: 1
  reference_file: null
  highlight_residues: []
  core: null
  regions: {}
sasa: solvent-accessible surface area of a target in each context, total and per residue (A^2)
  target: "protein"
  contexts: {}
  probe_radius_nm: 0.14
  n_sphere_points: 960
secondary_structure: DSSP secondary structure, fractions overall and per residue
  selection: "protein"
  scheme: "simplified"
hydrogen_bonds: hydrogen bonds between groups: counts, lifetimes, per-residue and per-pair occupancy
  groups: {"protein": null, "polymer": null}
  summaries: {"protein_polymer": {"between": ["protein", "polymer"]}}
  d_a_cutoff: 3.5
  d_h_a_angle_cutoff: 150.0
  donors: null
  hydrogens: null
  acceptors: null
  lifetime_key: "residue"
  tolerance_ps: 0.0
native_contacts: fraction of native contacts Q against a reference structure
  selection: "protein and not element H"
  reference_mode: null
  reference_frame: 1
  reference_file: null
  radius: 4.5
  min_separation: 3
  beta: 5.0
  lambda_constant: 1.8
  use_pbc: true
  regions: {}
contacts: contacts per protein residue with a partner group, the polymer by default or any polymer_selection such as resname SDS: method occlusion (buried surface) or distance
  method: "occlusion"
  polymer_selection: null
  protein_selection: null
  polymer_types: null
  use_pbc: true
  regions: {}
  cutoff: 4.0
  heavy_atoms: true
  exposed_threshold: 0.2
  buried_threshold: 0.2
  max_asa: "theoretical"
  probe_radius_nm: 0.14
  n_sphere_points: 960
  tolerance_ps: 0.0
distances: distances between atom pairs, and the fraction of frames below a threshold (A)
  pairs: null
  threshold: 3.5
  use_pbc: true
